beats.prompt: the dancer extends one arm straight forward palm down, then the other, then flips both palms up one after the other, and ends with both arms extended
one hand moves to the opposite shoulder, then the other hand, then one hand behind the head, then the other, and ends with both hands behind the head
both hands move to the hips one after the other and the hips circle in a wide slow loop, and end with hands still on the hips
the dancer does a small hop with a quarter turn to one side, and lands with feet together
the whole sequence repeats with bigger hip movement and a broad smile, ending with the hands on the hips
